mechanism: Both drugs increase serotonergic activity; duloxetine inhibits reuptake of serotonin and norepinephrine while isocarboxazid irreversibly inhibits monoamine oxidase, creating severe risk of serotonin syndrome and hypertensive crisis.
action: Contraindicated combination; do not use together; allow minimum 14 days washout after duloxetine before starting isocarboxazid, or 5 days after isocarboxazid before starting duloxetine.
